notes: Revenue and funding come from Epoch AI's 'Data on AI companies' (CC BY 4.0), which compiles company statements and media reports; each row links the original report.
Revenue type: 'run rate' and 'ARR' are annualized snapshots; 'full-year revenue' is a calendar-year total; 'annualized from period revenue' scales a quarter or half-year figure to a year.

Models: released in the last 24 months, with an Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) within 12 points of the best earlier model, plus each tracked lab's top 3 by ECI. Scores are the best across a model's tested versions or settings.
Benchmarks marked external are third-party leaderboards compiled by Epoch AI.

Deals come from Nodus42's curated log (market/ai_lab_deals.json); the date is the date of the cited filing or call; the link is the SEC filing or, for an earnings call, the company's investor-relations events page. Deals can overlap (a site named in one deal can be part of a larger commitment), so their GW are not added up.
